sloka: सुरा हि कथयन्ति त्वामागतं शूद्रघातिनम् ।ब्राह्मणस्य तु धर्मेण त्वया जीवापितः सुतः ।। ७.७६.२७ ॥
transliteration: surā hi kathayanti tvāmāgataṁ śūdraghātinam ।brāhmaṇasya tu dharmeṇa tvayā jīvāpitaḥ sutaḥ ।। 7.76.27 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the gods speak of you as having come after slaying the Shudra (Shambuka), and by your righteous action, the Brahmin's son was brought back to life.
